mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT i.ticker FROM Instruments i WHERE i.instrument_id IN ( SELECT o.instrument_id FROM Trades t JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = t.order_id GROUP BY o.instrument_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN o.side = 'BUY' THEN t.execution_quantity ELSE -t.execution_quantity END) <> 0 ) OR i.instrument_id IN (SELECT instrument_id FROM Watchlist_Items) ORDER BY i.ticker
